lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters is visible on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting a higher density and smaller diameter anteriorly, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced nodes posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes in a checkerboard-like structural arrangement across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with peak intensity on the dorsal edge and well-defined shadow casting immediately ventral to each ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical linear feature of high luminance, suggestive of a scar or scratch, is visible near the base of the pectoral fin and the posterior-most gill slit. Two dark, elongated objects (possibly remoras) are attached to the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal fish) in the immediate ventral and posterior periphery of the pectoral fin.
